Callout.Name: Officer Needs Assistance
Callout.Message: Officer requesting immediate assistance, shots fired.
Callout.Advisory: Officer on foot, suspect armed, no further detail.

Script.Line: We had nothing to do with that. We were walking home.
Do not come closer. I am telling you, do not come closer.
You are not taking me in. I am not going back there.

Lines.Approach: Shots fired and an officer is calling for help. Go, and go carefully.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
